coverage_statement: 36 curated architectures, not every physically possible hybrid. Screening and study-only capabilities are explicitly separated.

sources.name: NLR REopt: hybrid DER and resilience
sources.scope: Primary context for energy-system screening; no validation or affiliation claimed.

sources.name: NLR grid-forming inverter controls
sources.scope: Primary context for GFL/GFM and dynamic-study limitations.

technologies.name: Solar PV
technologies.boundary: AC-equivalent available PV output; not a site yield model.

technologies.name: Wind
technologies.boundary: Synthetic wind availability, not a turbine aerodynamic model.

technologies.name: Battery storage
technologies.boundary: Energy and power ratings with bounded SOC and conversion losses.

technologies.name: Hydroelectric
technologies.boundary: Fixed availability proxy; no reservoir or river balance.

technologies.name: Dispatchable generator
technologies.boundary: Simple electrical output proxy; no starts, fuel inventory or minimum loading.

technologies.name: Biomass CHP
technologies.boundary: Electricity/heat coupling needs a dedicated model.

technologies.name: Geothermal
technologies.boundary: Reservoir and thermal extraction are not modeled.

technologies.name: Useful heat
technologies.boundary: Thermal demand and temperature bounds are study-only.

technologies.name: Electrolyzer
technologies.boundary: Electric-to-hydrogen conversion is study-only.

technologies.name: Hydrogen storage
technologies.boundary: Mass balance and pressure constraints are study-only.

technologies.name: Fuel cell
technologies.boundary: Hydrogen-to-electric conversion is study-only.

technologies.name: Concentrated solar
technologies.boundary: Solar heat collection and turbine conversion are study-only.

technologies.name: Thermal storage
technologies.boundary: Thermal state of charge is not battery SOC.

technologies.name: Heat pump
technologies.boundary: Temperature-dependent COP and thermal load are study-only.

technologies.name: Bidirectional EV fleet
technologies.boundary: Per-vehicle SOC and departure obligations are study-only.

technologies.name: Pumped storage
technologies.boundary: Pumping, head and reservoir dynamics are study-only.

technologies.name: Flywheel
technologies.boundary: Sub-second support and self-discharge need dedicated modeling.

technologies.name: Supercapacitor
technologies.boundary: Transient and voltage dynamics are not modeled.

technologies.name: Tidal generation
technologies.boundary: Site-specific tidal power conversion is study-only.

technologies.name: Wave generation
technologies.boundary: Device power matrix and sea-state resource are study-only.

technologies.name: Nuclear generation
technologies.boundary: Conceptual energy integration only; no plant operating guidance.

technologies.name: Waste-to-energy
technologies.boundary: Feedstock, emissions and heat/electric conversion are study-only.

technologies.name: Network / aggregation
technologies.boundary: Multiple nodes, power flow and protection are not simulated.

systems.name: Remote renewable microgrid
systems.description: Keep an isolated community supplied across a renewable drought.
systems.learning_focus: Size energy reserve independently from inverter power.
systems.evidence: Critical-load measurements and a multi-year joint wind/solar weather record.

systems.name: Utility solar + storage · AC
systems.description: Shift a utility solar plant output through independently rated converters.
systems.learning_focus: Separate the shared grid connection limit from individual asset ratings.
systems.evidence: Point-of-interconnection agreement and AC conversion loss measurements.

systems.name: Utility solar + storage · DC
systems.description: Study shared conversion and storage on the DC side of a solar plant.
systems.learning_focus: An AC-equivalent screen cannot establish clipping recovery or DC protection.
systems.evidence: DC bus voltage envelope, inverter curve and DC-coupling design.

systems.name: Industrial solar + storage
systems.description: Manage site demand and self-consumption behind an industrial meter.
systems.learning_focus: Compare import peaks without calling one day an annual saving.
systems.evidence: Interval load data and actual demand-charge billing rules.

systems.name: Wind + battery firming
systems.description: Explore wind variability and limited battery headroom.
systems.learning_focus: Power adequacy and stored energy limit different services.
systems.evidence: Turbine power curves, measured wind and ramp-rate obligations.

systems.name: Hospital islanding microgrid
systems.description: Protect hospital critical loads through a planned grid interruption.
systems.learning_focus: Distinguish island energy adequacy from certified transfer performance.
systems.evidence: Critical circuits, transfer-switch study and tested grid-forming inverter response.

systems.name: Home solar + battery
systems.description: Explore evening consumption and backup energy in a small home.
systems.learning_focus: A backup-capable installation needs more than a battery label.
systems.evidence: Essential-circuit survey, installer design and outage measurements.

systems.name: Community energy hub
systems.description: Test a shared local demand profile and constrained export.
systems.learning_focus: Physical self-consumption is distinct from allocation and billing.
systems.evidence: Metering arrangement, shared-ownership terms and community load records.

systems.name: Off-grid DC telecom station
systems.description: Maintain continuous station demand through poor solar availability.
systems.learning_focus: DC bus regulation is analogous here; AC GFM terminology is not a DC control specification.
systems.evidence: Telecom DC voltage limits, converter efficiency and backup autonomy requirements.

systems.name: Solar + diesel + battery
systems.description: Reduce dispatchable generation in a remote diesel microgrid.
systems.learning_focus: A constant marginal generator model omits minimum loading and start costs.
systems.evidence: Fuel curve, fuel inventory and generator minimum-load specification.

systems.name: Wind + diesel + battery
systems.description: Support a wind-rich isolated site with a dispatchable backup.
systems.learning_focus: Weather diversity does not remove the need to budget backup energy.
systems.evidence: Measured wind, generator maintenance windows and fuel delivery constraints.

systems.name: Solar + wind + small hydro
systems.description: Combine complementary resources around a small hydro scheme.
systems.learning_focus: A fixed hydro availability factor is not a reservoir water balance.
systems.evidence: Seasonal river flow, environmental release and head measurements.

systems.name: Run-of-river + battery
systems.description: Inspect storage around a flow-constrained hydro plant.
systems.learning_focus: Reduce hydro availability without inventing stored-water flexibility.
systems.evidence: River flow-duration curve, turbine limits and ecological constraints.

systems.name: Floating solar + hydro + battery
systems.description: Study co-located floating PV and hydroelectric generation.
systems.learning_focus: Electrical aggregation does not quantify reservoir or water-quality effects.
systems.evidence: Mooring design, reservoir operations, environmental and grid studies.

systems.name: Biomass CHP + solar + battery
systems.description: Couple dispatchable biomass electricity to a useful heat demand.
systems.learning_focus: Credit heat only against a defined and useful thermal load.
systems.evidence: Fuel sustainability, heat demand, CHP efficiency and emissions evidence.

systems.name: Geothermal + solar energy hub
systems.description: Explore firm geothermal output alongside daytime solar.
systems.learning_focus: Reservoir sustainability and thermal delivery require separate models.
systems.evidence: Reservoir data, reinjection design, plant availability and heat contracts.

systems.name: Solar + hydrogen + battery
systems.description: Contrast short-duration batteries with stored hydrogen pathways.
systems.learning_focus: Track electrolyzer, storage and fuel-cell conversion losses separately.
systems.evidence: Electrolyzer map, hydrogen inventory, storage losses and fuel-cell response.

systems.name: Wind + hydrogen export hub
systems.description: Match variable wind with electrolyzer operation and hydrogen offtake.
systems.learning_focus: Electrical production and hydrogen sales cannot use the same energy twice.
systems.evidence: Water, compression, electrolyzer load range and offtake specifications.

systems.name: Concentrated solar + thermal storage
systems.description: Explore a solar heat store and dispatchable turbine cycle.
systems.learning_focus: Thermal megawatt-hours are not electrical megawatt-hours.
systems.evidence: DNI weather series, thermal losses, heat-engine efficiency and startup heat.

systems.name: PV + heat pump + thermal store
systems.description: Coordinate electric demand with a building thermal store.
systems.learning_focus: Heat-pump COP varies with operating temperatures.
systems.evidence: Building heat loss, comfort bounds, COP curves and storage losses.

systems.name: District CHP + thermal storage
systems.description: Study coupled heat/electricity supply to a district network.
systems.learning_focus: A heat-led operating schedule differs from electricity-only dispatch.
systems.evidence: Hourly heat demand, network losses and CHP feasible operating region.

systems.name: Solar + battery EV depot
systems.description: Represent aggregate charging demand at an electric vehicle depot.
systems.learning_focus: Aggregate demand is not proof that every vehicle departs charged.
systems.evidence: Charging intervals, arrival/departure schedules and connection capacity.

systems.name: Bidirectional fleet + solar
systems.description: Study vehicle-to-grid flexibility and mobility obligations.
systems.learning_focus: Do not spend vehicle energy required for the next trip.
systems.evidence: Vehicle availability, charger interoperability, driver consent and warranty terms.

systems.name: Port shore-power microgrid
systems.description: Inspect large shore-power demand and outage support.
systems.learning_focus: Critical-load classification must be agreed with port operators.
systems.evidence: Vessel connection schedules, shore-power standards and emergency demand.

systems.name: Data-centre hybrid backup
systems.description: Test energy adequacy for critical computing loads.
systems.learning_focus: Hourly adequacy cannot establish UPS ride-through or tier certification.
systems.evidence: UPS design, transfer sequences, redundancy and measured IT/cooling demand.

systems.name: Agrivoltaics + irrigation storage
systems.description: Explore daytime generation and farm pumping demand.
systems.learning_focus: Energy dispatch alone does not establish crop or biodiversity outcomes.
systems.evidence: Crop-shading study, irrigation needs, pumping curve and ecological baseline.

systems.name: Renewable desalination microgrid
systems.description: Study the electrical supply of a remote water plant.
systems.learning_focus: Water storage and product quality are outside the electrical screen.
systems.evidence: Desalination power curve, water demand, intake and brine permits.

systems.name: Wind + PV + pumped storage
systems.description: Investigate a renewable plant with pumped hydro storage.
systems.learning_focus: Water head, pumping and generation paths require a dedicated storage model.
systems.evidence: Reservoir geometry, head curves, water permits and pump-turbine efficiency.

systems.name: Battery + flywheel microgrid
systems.description: Allocate rapid power support and longer energy delivery.
systems.learning_focus: An hourly model cannot resolve sub-second flywheel services.
systems.evidence: Power response, bearing losses, cycle limits and validated dynamic models.

systems.name: PV + battery + supercapacitor
systems.description: Separate fast transient support from sustained energy.
systems.learning_focus: DC-link transients need much finer time resolution than hourly dispatch.
systems.evidence: Voltage-dependent capacitance, ESR, converter limits and control data.

systems.name: Tidal + wave + battery
systems.description: Investigate complementary marine renewable resources.
systems.learning_focus: Site-specific tidal and wave conversion are not generic wind profiles.
systems.evidence: Marine resource record, device power matrices and environmental constraints.

systems.name: Offshore wind + hydrogen island
systems.description: Explore offshore electric and hydrogen export pathways.
systems.learning_focus: Do not omit transmission, compression or marine operating constraints.
systems.evidence: Cable ratings, electrolyzer auxiliaries, hydrogen export and marine safety studies.

systems.name: Nuclear + hydrogen + heat
systems.description: Study an integrated firm-energy and hydrogen concept.
systems.learning_focus: An educational diagram is not a nuclear plant safety or licensing assessment.
systems.evidence: Authorized plant operating limits, heat integration and independent safety review.

systems.name: Waste-to-energy district hub
systems.description: Study electricity and useful heat from a mixed-resource hub.
systems.learning_focus: Feedstock accounting and lifecycle boundaries need independent review.
systems.evidence: Feedstock composition, emissions controls, heat contracts and waste hierarchy review.

systems.name: Virtual power plant portfolio
systems.description: Aggregate distributed assets without pretending they share one bus.
systems.learning_focus: Virtual aggregation must preserve each site and network constraint.
systems.evidence: Site-level meter data, communications, customer permissions and settlement rules.

systems.name: Networked community microgrids
systems.description: Study coordinated islanding across multiple local networks.
systems.learning_focus: A one-bus energy model cannot validate network power flows or protection.
systems.evidence: Feeder impedances, switching plan, protection settings and coordinated control study.

scenarios.name: Reference day
scenarios.description: Establish a repeatable 24-hour reference before applying stress.

scenarios.name: Cloud cover
scenarios.description: Reduce solar availability to 25% of the synthetic profile.

scenarios.name: Wind lull
scenarios.description: Reduce wind availability to 15% of the synthetic profile.

scenarios.name: Renewable drought
scenarios.description: Stress both resources together; diversity is not a guarantee.

scenarios.name: Heatwave demand
scenarios.description: Increase load by 40% and reduce solar by 10%; no thermal model.

scenarios.name: Winter peak
scenarios.description: Increase load and reduce solar; synthetic, not measured winter data.

scenarios.name: Evening load step
scenarios.description: Increase demand 60% from hour 17 through hour 20 each day.

scenarios.name: Four-hour outage
scenarios.description: Disconnect the grid during the evening peak.

scenarios.name: 24-hour outage
scenarios.description: Test one complete day without grid support.

scenarios.name: 72-hour outage
scenarios.description: Repeat a synthetic daily profile for three days; not a weather forecast.

scenarios.name: Black-start sequence
scenarios.description: Study energization, auxiliary supply and protection before claiming a black start.

scenarios.name: Grid reconnection
scenarios.description: Study synchronization, protection and transfer logic; no dynamic simulation.

scenarios.name: Weak-grid stability
scenarios.description: Study inverter interaction and voltage/frequency stability using dedicated models.

scenarios.name: Ramp-rate compliance
scenarios.description: Study a delivery ramp requirement; hourly greedy dispatch does not enforce it.

scenarios.name: Zero-export constraint
scenarios.description: Enforce zero export at the point of connection.

scenarios.name: Export bottleneck
scenarios.description: Reduce the configured export limit to 15%.

scenarios.name: Import bottleneck
scenarios.description: Reduce the configured import limit to 20%.

scenarios.name: Negative midday prices
scenarios.description: Apply a negative midday import tariff; the policy does not optimize arbitrage.

scenarios.name: Evening tariff spike
scenarios.description: Triple the evening import tariff; do not infer annual revenue.

scenarios.name: Aged battery
scenarios.description: Reduce effective battery capacity to 70%, preserving SOC fractions.

scenarios.name: Battery converter outage
scenarios.description: Disable charge and discharge power for the whole run.

scenarios.name: Generator unavailable
scenarios.description: Remove dispatchable backup for the whole run.

scenarios.name: Low river flow
scenarios.description: Reduce hydro availability to 20% of its baseline proxy.

scenarios.name: Higher reserve floor
scenarios.description: Hold 50% of effective battery energy as an unavailable reserve.

lessons.title: Remote renewable microgrid
objectives: Size energy reserve independently from inverter power.
Explain the Off-grid connection and AC energy boundary.
Identify the evidence needed to challenge the result.

steps.title: Map the energy path
steps.body: Keep an isolated community supplied across a renewable drought. Select each asset in the 3D scene and read its model boundary.

steps.title: Change one assumption
steps.body: Run the reference case, pin it, then run Renewable drought. Compare served load, grid import and terminal stored energy.

steps.title: Challenge the evidence
steps.body: Critical-load measurements and a multi-year joint wind/solar weather record. Explain why a short synthetic profile cannot establish annual value or dynamic stability.

quiz.question: What is the key modeling distinction in this lesson?
options: Size energy reserve independently from inverter power.
Assume nameplate ratings establish annual performance.
Treat the 3D diagram as a certified engineering design.
Transfer results from a different site without checking assumptions.
quiz.explanation: Size energy reserve independently from inverter power.

quiz.question: Which evidence is most relevant before extending this lesson to a real project?
options: A high GitHub star count.
A screenshot of the dashboard without input data.
Critical-load measurements and a multi-year joint wind/solar weather record.
The same default profile reused without provenance.
quiz.explanation: Critical-load measurements and a multi-year joint wind/solar weather record.
